msg: f14 COORDINATOR wake (Mike-DC): you do NOT fill, you WAKE f4. STEP 1 settle: run python C:/claude_base/tools/mike_dc_calendar/pine_settle_check.py ; if it prints WAIT secs, re-arm a ScheduleWakeup for that many secs with THIS same prompt and STOP. If GO, continue. STEP 2: force-wake f4 via python C:/claude_base/branch_bulletin/bcast.py wake --name f4 telling it to do its Mike-DC fill now (read Mike inbox, research headless WebSearch only, add events to Mike-in-DC calendar + Notion DB, reply Mike once if he wrote, ping heartbeat cd162bbb ONLY after a real fill). STEP 3: post one board line that you triggered f4, and if f4 has no live listener note it. Do NOT fill or reply to Mike yourself. Recurs daily; catches up on Pine resume.
